## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the failure or agreed improvement. Link the relevant issue and any
agreed feature scope. Keep the change focused on that problem.

## Verification

Give reproduction steps, the focused checks you ran, their results, and anything
you could not verify. Include before/after evidence for UI changes and a short
recording when motion matters. Remove personal data and pairing credentials.

See [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and review expectations.
